description: Hash EIP-712 typed data (typed_data as JSON text, as passed to eth_signTypedData_v4): encoded type, domain separator, struct hash and digest. With an existing public signature (65-byte or EIP-2098 64-byte) it recovers the signer address and low_s flag; with signer it reports valid or signer_mismatch. Optional expect_chain_id / expect_verifying_contract assert the domain (status chain_id_mismatch or verifying_contract_mismatch). For permits (EIP-2612, DAI, Permit2 single, batch and transfer) the result shows the spender and amounts; expect_spender / expect_amount / expect_unlimited assert them (status spender_not_expected, amount_not_expected or unlimited_approval; spender_not_checkable or amount_not_checkable for typed data that is not a recognised permit). Seaport 1.5 / 1.6 orders (OrderComponents, BulkOrder) show what the signer receives and fail closed: seaport_no_consideration when nothing returns to the signer, seaport_unknown_deployment, seaport_not_checkable; expect_min_consideration (smallest units, e.g. native:N or 0xTOKEN:N, comma-separated) adds seaport_dust_consideration. Checks existing signatures only; never signs. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

expect_amount.description: Decimal amount every permit entry must equal (needs a recognised permit); else amount_not_expected

expect_chain_id.description: Decimal chain id the domain must carry; else status chain_id_mismatch

expect_min_consideration.description: Seaport order: minimum the signer must receive, smallest units: N, native:N or 0xTOKEN:N, comma-separated; else status seaport_dust_consideration

expect_spender.description: Address a permit's spender must equal; else status spender_not_expected

expect_unlimited.description: Needs expect_spender; accept an unlimited approval (2^128 or more) to that spender instead of status unlimited_approval

expect_verifying_contract.description: Address the domain's verifyingContract must equal; else verifying_contract_mismatch

name: typed_data_verify
title: EIP-712 typed data hash / signer check (dev tool)
